messages:
Milan Ortega: hey folks! joined infra today — Milan here. usually remote in SEA (UTC+1). I bring a folding guitar, an overenthusiastic basil plant, and very strong opinions about soup. excited to meet you all :guitar::herb::soup:
Rhea Patel: welcome Milan!! buddy assigned (Connor). badge pickup is at People Ops after 10am. also the basil plot is legit — bring snacks not soil :sun_with_face::seedling:
Connor Yu: hi Milan :) Ill ping you for a quick setup walk-through. also folding guitar? we have a 3pm "mellow unplugged" in the lounge every other Thursday if you want to crash it :notes:
Milan Ortega: very tempted. whats the lounge rules? can I bring a tiny amp? :speaker_small::grin:
Cassidy Rambo: tiny amp ok as long as its not summoned during all-hands. PS: lunchtime poll  soup vs sandwiches? vote :soup: or :sandwich: (were doing a team buy today)
Milan Ortega: :soup: — spicy please, prove my soup hill is worth climbing
Rhea Patel: :sandwich: for me today but I will defend soup on cold days. also FYI onboarding-bot put a "Welcome Meet" on your calendar at 11:00 :robot_face:
onboarding-bot: Welcome Milan! A buddy (Connor Yu) has been assigned. Check your DMs for onboarding checklist and access docs. :robot_face:
Connor Yu: sent you the DM with the infra quickstart. if you run into SSO issues ping #eng-help or DM me directly. badge tip: People Ops sometimes has a line, so early birds beat the queue :alarm_clock::idcard:
Milan Ortega: got the DM, and the calendar invite. stopped by People Ops after the intro — badge all sorted. thanks all for the warm welcome! :smile:
Cassidy Rambo: welcome again Milan! bring that guitar to the next rooftop snack and well do a tiny jam after tacos :taco::guitar:
